messages.content:
Answer a fixed set of questions about the state the user provides. Each question lists its allowed answers; reply with exactly one label per question.

Question action: Choose the single safe and best action for the dinosaur based on the physics planner analysis in the state.
  a: jump (Jump over ground obstacles when jump is marked Safe and Best.)
  b: duck (Duck under low/mid-height pterodactyls or drop fast when duck is marked Safe and Best.)
  c: run (Keep running on the ground when run is marked Safe and Best.)

Reply with one line per question, in this order, formatted as "id: label".

Dino runner game. small cactus ahead, 67 px away.
Action analysis:
- jump: Safe. Clears the small cactus. Best.
- duck: Unsafe. Hits the small cactus. Collision.
- run: Unsafe. Hits the small cactus. Collision.
